correctness.rationale: The full finite simplicial chain complex is enumerated, with face counts [15,75,145,90,6] and exact rational boundary ranks [14,61,79,6]. Exact RREF and invertible selected minors compute all image-action traces; signed boundary equivariance is checked on every simplex for all 120 elements. Every group class matches the two formulae, and the two module identifications follow by rational character theory. The quotient corollary uses exactness of invariants for finite groups over Q. Full rational computation is a proof for this finite object; no unproved infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The complete natural S5-modules in both positive homological degrees of the Petersen matching complex are structural equivariant invariants; the two five-dimensional modules are different (one reducible sign-twisted permutation, one irreducible Specht). Ordinary Betti ranks do not determine this distinction. The rationally acyclic orbit space is a substantive consequence on a canonical symmetric graph, not a numerically arbitrary subcase.
